text:
jun: Quick ping — opened a small cleanup PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821
jun: It’s mostly moving exports around and splitting a couple of large modules. No behavior changes expected but import paths shift.
jun: PTAL when you have a minute — main asks: sanity-check export surface, watch for stray `any` types, and eyeball the module split. cc @olivia @sam

olivia: on it, will skim after stand :thumbsup:
sam: I can take a pass later today. quick q — did you run the monorepo build? any migration script?
jun: ran `yarn build:all` locally, no failures. added a short migration note in the PR description (search for MIGRATE_EXPORTS).
jun: small example of the change that caused most diffs:
```
- export { oldHelper as helper } from './helpers';
+ export { newHelper as helper } from './core/new-helpers';
```

maya: left one nit — I think we should keep the legacy barrel for one release to avoid churn for downstream packages. left a comment on the PR.
eli: CI found a lint error in `eng-common/src/index.ts` (unused export). I pushed a tiny fix to the branch (will re-run CI).
ci-bot: ci/build #4821 — lint error fixed by eli — re-running checks...
sam: skimmed the diff. overall looks good. left two comments about an implicit `any` and a long function that could be split. nothing blocking.
olivia: small suggestion: split `adapters.ts` into `adapters/core.ts` + `adapters/legacy.ts` to make future reviews easier. not required for this PR, but might be a follow-up.
jun: thanks — I added a TODO in the PR and noted the follow-up in the description. plan is to merge after CI is green and we have one more approval.
sam: I can approve once the `any` is addressed (should be quick).
maya: +1 — will approve after the migration note is added to CHANGELOG.
jun: added CHANGELOG entry and fixed the `any`. CI passed. merging in ~30m unless anyone objects.
